model_meta.description: Concept model of an adjustable compliant mechanism using two perpendicular sliders, resilient members, a pivoting link, and adjustment of resilient-member length to provide an adjustable substantially constant force.

subsystems.description: Two support structures constrain respective sliders along perpendicular translational axes.
First and second slidable structures translate along their respective support structures; applied force is received at the first slider.
Two equal-stiffness resilient members act on respective sliders; changing one member's length adjusts force output.
A link is pivotally coupled directly or indirectly to both sliders and transfers force between them.
Mechanically coupled adjustment block or mechanism changes length of one resilient member; embodiments include threaded rod, movable head, or adjustment pin.

External applied-force boundary, representing force applied to the first slider directly or optionally through a mechanical connector; user/connector are contextual embodiments, not required mechanism components.
Abstract boundary representing the mechanism's substantially constant acting force against applied force; no receiving load is asserted.

item_flows.name: Applied force
item_flows.notes: External force applied to first slider.

item_flows.name: Opposing force
item_flows.notes: Substantially constant acting force provided against the applied force; modeled at the mechanism boundary without asserting a separate receiving load.

requirements.statement: With equal-stiffness resilient members, provide a substantially constant acting force against applied force as sliders translate along the full respective support-axis lengths.
requirements.rationale: Claim 1; claim 7 states the corresponding behavior across translational axes.

actions.name: Adjust force setting by changing resilient-member length

steps.description: Mechanically change the length of one resilient member using the adjustment mechanism.
The changed resilient-member equilibrium/length adjusts the mechanism's force output.

actions.name: Transmit applied force and provide opposing force

steps.description: Applied force moves the first slider and loads its resilient member.
The pivoting link transfers a portion of the applied force to the second slider, loading its resilient member.
The coupled mechanism provides a substantially constant opposing force over the stated slider travel.
